choose.when: SELECT batch_id,capture_id,window_key,payload_hash,state,row_count,receipt, SHA2(#{records_json},256) AS requested_hash FROM kemai_pipeline_probe_batches WHERE batch_id=#{batch_id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT batch_id,payload_hash,state,row_count,receipt FROM kemai_pipeline_probe_batches WHERE capture_id=#{capture_id} AND window_key=#{window_key} ORDER BY batch_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT window_key,capture_id,row_count,evidence FROM kemai_pipeline_probe_windows WHERE window_key=#{window_key}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM kemai_pipeline_probe_records r JOIN kemai_pipeline_probe_batches b ON r.last_batch_id=b.batch_id WHERE b.capture_id=#{capture_id} AND b.window_key=#{window_key} AND b.state='committed'
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM kemai_pipeline_probe_records WHERE last_batch_id=#{batch_id}
